title: Add senderMsgId to Message, implement idempotent Peer/deliver
description:
The I-D distinguishes two ULIDs on every message: id (assigned by the receiving mailbox) and senderMsgId (assigned by the sender, carried in Peer/deliver). For owner-composed messages, both are the same ULID.

This enables idempotent delivery: if Peer/deliver arrives twice with the same senderMsgId for the same chat, the second delivery is silently dropped and the original receivedAt is returned.

kith-core/src/message.rs:
- Add sender_msg_id: String field (serde: senderMsgId)

kith-store/src/message.rs:
- insert gains sender_msg_id: &str parameter
- Add find_by_sender_msg_id(chat_id, sender_msg_id) -> Option<Message> for idempotency check

kith-store/src/lib.rs:
- insert_message_with_attachments gains sender_msg_id param

kith-peer/src/lib.rs:
- Receiver generates fresh ULID as id; sender's msg.id becomes sender_msg_id
- Before inserting: check find_by_sender_msg_id; if found return accepted=true with stored receivedAt

kith-chat/src/ (Message/set create):
- Owner-composed messages: sender_msg_id = id (same ULID)

Depends on: KITH-j4v2, KITH-5nj3
